content.text: In regions like Nigeria and Venezuela, traditional platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often inaccessible, forcing digital creators to seek alternatives. This guide provides a step-by-step approach to establishing a fully operational digital store using [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-21|cloudflare]] Pages, enabling you to accept crypto payments without the need for conventional payment processors. With COREMERCH's infrastructure, you can confidently build your online store, ensuring complete ownership and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-google-apps-script-digital-commerce-33|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-actually-21|Sovereign Commerce]]ty over your digital assets.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The failure of conventional payment platforms in many regions highlights the necessity for a robust and independent infrastructure. COREMERCH offers a solution that eliminates reliance on third-party platforms, allowing creators to own their commerce stack. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you create a solution that guarantees autonomy and reliability, ensuring that you can conduct transactions without interruption or limitations imposed by external services.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, gather essential tools and resources. You will need a GitHub account for hosting your store, access to Cloudflare for managing your pages, and a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for backend logic and ensure you have your digital products ready for upload. Having these components in place will streamline your deployment process, making the setup efficient and straightforward.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your payment layer with NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a minimal fee of 0.5%. Create a webhook that will trigger upon payment confirmation, ensuring that your digital products are delivered instantly after a successful transaction. Utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for storing your digital assets, allowing for seamless delivery to customers. This setup ensures your store operates smoothly, providing an efficient user experience.
Take control of your digital commerce with infrastructure sovereignty.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After deploying your digital store, it’s time to launch. Test your payment processing by making a small transaction with a cryptocurrency supported by NOWPayments. Monitor the instant delivery of your digital product to confirm everything is functioning correctly. This live test is crucial, as it ensures that your infrastructure is fully operational and ready to handle real customer orders immediately after launch.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is live and stable, consider how to scale effectively. You can add more products and promotional campaigns to drive traffic. Explore using the Edge Commerce Stack offered by COREMERCH for additional features like advanced analytics and enhanced customer engagement tools. As you scale, ensure your backend remains efficient, and continue monitoring transaction processes to maintain a high level of service.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
No subscriptions, no limitations — own your entire stack.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build your digital store using Cloudflare Pages for free hosting and integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing. This combination allows you to operate independently of traditional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?
Stack 01, using GitHub Pages and Apps Script, can be deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages and Workers, offering a more robust solution deployed by COREMERCH within 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting a digital product store. They provide reliable infrastructure without the high costs associated with traditional platforms.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments offers over 300 cryptocurrency options, competitive transaction fees of 0.5%, and no KYC requirements. This makes it an ideal choice for digital creators looking to accept crypto payments seamlessly.
How can I ensure the delivery of my digital products is automated?

Set up webhooks in NOWPayments that trigger product delivery automatically upon transaction confirmation. Combine this with reliable storage solutions like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for seamless delivery.
